description: Source code for exporting and serializing PyTorch JIT modules, including functions for module serialization, bytecode handling, debug info, and source range serialization.

classes.name: ModuleMethod
classes.description: Represents a module, its function, and export name for internal processing.

methods.name: getOptionsFromGlobal
methods.description: Retrieves compilation options based on global settings.

methods.name: to_tuple
methods.description: Converts initializer list or vector of IValues into a tuple IValue.

methods.name: Table
methods.description: Creates a table (IValue) from a vector of key-value pairs.

methods.name: GetExtraFilesHook
methods.description: Returns reference to the static hook for extra files.

methods.name: get_named_tuple_str_or_default
methods.description: Generates string representation for NamedTuple types or returns default.

methods.name: getFunctionTuple
methods.description: Creates a tuple representing a function's code, schema, and debug info.

methods.name: pushMobileFunctionsToIValues
methods.description: Pushes mobile-optimized function representations into IValue vectors.

methods.name: isLoweredModule
methods.description: Checks if a module is a lowered (optimized) module.

methods.name: getBackendDebugInfoMap
methods.description: Recursively collects backend debug info from a module and its children.

methods.name: getBackendSourceRanges
methods.description: Collects source range info from a module for debugging.

methods.name: enableMobileInterfaceCallExport
methods.description: Enables export of mobile interface calls.

methods.name: SetExportModuleExtraFilesHook
methods.description: Sets a hook for adding extra files during module export.

methods.name: writeExtraFiles
methods.description: Writes extra files and hook-provided files during serialization.

methods.name: convertTypes
methods.description: Converts and records types for serialization.

methods.name: writeFiles
methods.description: Writes source code files and debug info for modules.

methods.name: writeByteCode
methods.description: Serializes bytecode and debug info for a module.

methods.name: writeArchive
methods.description: Serializes an IValue into archive files, including tensors.

methods.name: save_mobile_module_to_bytes
methods.description: Serializes a mobile module into bytes.

methods.name: save_jit_module_to_bytes
methods.description: Serializes a JIT module into bytes.

methods.name: save_jit_module_to_write_func
methods.description: Serializes a JIT module using a custom writer function.

methods.name: export_opnames
methods.description: Extracts operation names from a module.

methods.name: type_printer
methods.description: Generates string representation of a type for serialization.

methods.name: convertNamedType
methods.description: Serializes a named type (class) into source code.

methods.name: serialize_unified_format
methods.description: Serializes a module into a unified format with source code and constants.

methods.name: storage_context
methods.description: Provides access to the storage context used during serialization.

methods.name: ExportModule
methods.description: Exports a module to a stream or file, serializing code, constants, and debug info.

methods.name: save_jit_module
methods.description: Serializes a JIT module to a file.
